fields.description: Choosing a hosted provider fills in its standard API URL. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Stored encrypted. Never sent to the browser or any API response. Leave blank for a local model that needs no key.

fields.label: API Key Help
fields.options: For maximum secrecy the key can instead be placed in the server's site_config.json as ai_crm_api_key. A key set there takes precedence, is never written to the database, and cannot be read back through any HTTP endpoint.
